errors.text_span: 最高柱子位于重叠率0.2处，其高度约为1800；紧随其后的是重叠率0.2处的柱子，高度约为1600
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly describes the locations of the two tallest bars. In the histogram, the tallest bar is located in the bin just before the 0.2 tick mark on the x-axis, not at it. The second tallest bar is in the bin just after the 0.2 tick mark. Describing both as being "at" 0.2 is factually incorrect and contradictory.

errors.text_span: 重叠率0.4处柱子高度约为400
errors.evidence: The height of the bar corresponding to the bin centered around an Overlap Ratio of 0.4 is approximately 350. The stated value of 400 is a significant overestimation.
